Use Jev through the TypeSafe API

Source: R/deciders.R
decider_typesafe.Rd

Makes a decider for a Jev model on the TypeSafe API (https://api.typesafe.ai, SystemOne format).

Usage

decider_typesafe(model = NULL, credentials = NULL, input = NULL)

Arguments

model

The model name, for example "jev-1.13.0". NULL (the default) uses "jev-latest" and prints a message that names it.

credentials

A function with no arguments that returns the key. NULL (the default) reads the environment variable TYPESAFE_API_KEY each time decide() sends requests. You generally should not need this argument. Set TYPESAFE_API_KEY instead. The best place to set it is .Renviron. Open that file with usethis::edit_r_environ(). The usethis package is optional: you can also edit .Renviron by hand. Give a function for more control, for example to read the key from a secret store. The decider keeps the function, not the key.

input

The input type that the model reads: "text", "image" or "text+image". NULL (the default) takes it from the internal table of input types; a model that is not in the table is not checked. decide() stops before any request when an input does not fit.

Value

A decider object for decide(). It holds no key.

Details

You need a TypeSafe API key. Get one in the TypeSafe console (https://console.typesafe.ai/), then set the environment variable TYPESAFE_API_KEY. The TypeSafe documentation is at https://docs.typesafe.ai/introduction.

Image input is experimental: TypeSafe reads images only with the header TypeSafe-Danger-Zone-Images: true, which decide() sends whenever a request carries an image. TypeSafe does not report a cost, so .cost is NA in the output of decide(). On 2026-10-23, TypeSafe refused images under 280 pixels on the longest side. So use upscale = TRUE for small images (see vignette("images")).

See also

Other deciders: decider_foundry(), decider_openai(), decider_openrouter(), decider_systemone()

Examples

decider_typesafe("jev-1.13.0")
#> <decider> TypeSafe
#> * Model: jev-1.13.0
#> * URL: https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone
#> * Request format: systemone
#> * Input: text+image
# A function can give the key, for example from another variable:
decider_typesafe("jev-1.13.0", credentials = \() Sys.getenv("MY_JEV_KEY"))
#> <decider> TypeSafe
#> * Model: jev-1.13.0
#> * URL: https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone
#> * Request format: systemone
#> * Input: text+image
